title: Active pipeline watchdogs
summary: Added continuous-mode round-failure watchdogs, pending-publish scheduling backpressure, pause-flag stale evidence, queue execution caps, and runtime config defaults.
reason: Long unattended runs need the scheduler to stop feeding risky backlog growth, preserve Once-mode failure semantics, and surface blocked evidence instead of looping indefinitely after repeated unexpected failures.
behavior_before: Continuous failures, pending-publish backlog, stale pause flags, and oversized runnable queue sets did not have the requested bounded unattended behavior.
behavior_after: Continuous mode enters bounded probe backoff after configured failure limits, pending-publish backlog can block new queue work while safe retry/evidence refresh continues, stale pause flags are reported, and queue execution is capped per round.
rollback_plan: Revert the PowerShell scheduler/watchdog/config changes and related schema/test updates; existing pending-publish manifests and source media remain untouched.
notes: Add continuous round watchdogs, pending-publish backpressure, pause stale evidence, and runtime config defaults.
